svg.title: Step 5: watch light and shadow on the terrain
svg.desc: Step 5: watch light and shadow on the terrain
svg.text: Switch between the 2D shaded map and the 3D view.
Local terrain lit by the real Sun direction. Dark areas are true cast shadows.
Key: lit, in shadow, no height data.
Turn the 3D view with the slider. Heights are exaggerated 2x, and it says so.
